nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Coordinate Descent CV Target Guard Helper Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic target-shape, sparse-input, and scalar-sample-weight guard helpers from sklearn.linear_model._coordinate_descent.LinearModelCV.fit.

nodes.name: cd_cv_reference_preserving_validation_branch
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit uses the ndarray-or-sparse validation branch that keeps a reference to X.

inputs.name: x_is_ndarray
inputs.type_desc: whether X is a numpy ndarray

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether LinearModelCV.fit takes the reference-preserving validation branch

nodes.name: cd_cv_non_multitask_guard_required
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit should reject multi-output y when the estimator is not multitask.
nodes.type_signature: (multitask: bool, y_ndim: int, y_width: int) -> bool

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the non-multitask multi-output guard should fire

nodes.name: cd_cv_non_multitask_message
nodes.description: Return the non-multitask multi-output ValueError text used by LinearModelCV.fit.

nodes.name: cd_cv_multitask_sparse_guard_required
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit should reject sparse X in multitask mode.

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the sparse multitask guard should fire

nodes.name: cd_cv_multitask_sparse_message
nodes.description: Return the multitask sparse-input TypeError text used by LinearModelCV.fit.

inputs.name: guard_required
inputs.type_desc: whether the sparse multitask guard fires

nodes.name: cd_cv_multitask_monotask_guard_required
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit should reject mono-task y in multitask mode.

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether the mono-task multitask guard should fire

nodes.name: cd_cv_multitask_monotask_message
nodes.description: Return the multitask mono-task ValueError text used by LinearModelCV.fit.

inputs.name: class_name
inputs.type_desc: estimator class name beginning with MultiTask

nodes.name: cd_cv_scalar_sample_weight_becomes_none
nodes.description: Return whether LinearModelCV.fit replaces scalar sample_weight with None before validation.

inputs.name: sample_weight_is_number
inputs.type_desc: whether sample_weight is a Python number

outputs.name: result
outputs.type_desc: whether scalar sample_weight is normalized to None
